meta.name: pr-create
meta.description: Creates a pull request from current changes, monitors GitHub CI, and debugs any failures until CI passes. Activate when the user says "create pr", "make a pr", "open pull request", "submit pr", "pr for these changes", or wants to get their current work into a reviewable PR. Assumes the project uses git, is hosted on GitHub, and has GitHub Actions CI with automated checks (lint, build, tests, etc.). Does NOT merge - stops when CI passes and provides the PR link.

copy.tagline: 自动创建 PR 并监控 CI 直到通过
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要从当前改动创建 PR 并等待 CI 通过。
